item.title: Mean Girls
item.description:
Wednesday, September 2, 2026 at 2 PM

By midweek, we could all use a little pick-me-up. Wine Wednesdays are your perfect excuse to press pause on your problems and pour a glass instead. Each ticket includes a complimentary glass of house wine—so you can toast being halfway to the weekend with friends (or a very good date). Then sink into our ultra-comfortable seats and enjoy a fan-favorite film under the stars. Midweek meltdown? Best handled with a movie. 🍷🎬

Event details

item.title: The Proposal
item.description:
Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 2 PM

No Girls Night Out or Slumber Party would be complete without a Sandra Bullock classic! She's the queen of versatility- from thrillers to rom coms, Sandy does it all! All while looking fabulously put together and effortlessly cool. Join us for a fan favorite, THE PROPOSAL, and watch Ryan Renolds fall for our girl through hilarious mishaps and overbearing familial intrusion!

Event details

item.title: Sinners
item.description:
Tuesday, September 22, 2026 at 2:15 PM

Sinners is more than just a horror film- it walks the fine line between being seductive and scary. It's story telling at its finest and best experienced on the big screen. Don't miss this unforgettable movie!

item.title: The First Wives Club
item.description:
Thursday, September 24, 2026 at 2 PM

It's been 30 years since The First Wives Club taught women everywhere how to take their power back. Goldie, Bette, and Diane — the original badass blueprint. Come dressed in your finest white suit set for a night of justice, glamour, and watching every salty ex get exactly what he deserves. And yes, we expect dancing in the aisles to "You Don't Own Me."
